# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_LEVEL_TEST

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When SPY gaps open beyond a named resistance/support level and then tests that level with weak volume, the gap tends to fade, offering a mean-reversion trade opposite the gap direction. This edge exists because weak volume on the test indicates lack of conviction to continue the gap move, increasing the probability of a reversion to the pre-gap price level.

## Mechanism

Entry: If opening price > named resistance level (e.g., prior day high) AND the first 5-minute bar closes below that level with volume < 0.8x the average volume of the first 5-minute bars of the last 10 days, enter short at that close (reverse for gaps below support: open < named support AND first 5-min bar closes above support with volume < 0.8x avg volume of last 10 days' first 5-min bars, enter long).  
Exit: Initial stop at chart-stop (gap extreme: for shorts, stop above gap high; for longs, stop below gap low). TP1 at 1.5R (risk = entry to stop). Runner trail: 12% off high-water mark (for shorts) or low-water mark (for longs). Regime filter: Only active when VIX < 20 and within first 30 minutes of session (09:30-10:00 ET).
